name: Velum
description: A premium personal diary. Your life, in your words.
fullDescription: Velum is a private and elegant space for your thoughts. Write unlimited entries with rich text, track your mood, revisit memories and build a daily writing streak. Everything stays encrypted on your device, with app lock, PIN and optional face unlock for quick access. No ads, no analytics and no unnecessary permissions.
features: Unlimited diary entries with rich text and autosave
Mood tracking, favourites and powerful search
Calendar view, streaks and writing statistics
Daily prompts, templates and Memories
Velum Face ID as a quick unlock, with PIN fallback
Fingerprint and device biometric support
Encrypted local database and secure backups
Liquid OS glass interface with a custom gradient engine
Dark, AMOLED and light themes
changelog: Added Velum Face ID with PIN fallback
Added Liquid Glass, Aurora and Midnight themes

name: QR Studio
description: Fast offline QR and barcode scanner with a built-in generator.
fullDescription: QR Studio scans QR codes and barcodes instantly using an on-device model, so nothing leaves your phone. Create codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, email, phone numbers and contacts, then save, search and favourite everything in your history. Designed to run smoothly even on phones with 3 GB of RAM.
features: Instant offline QR and barcode scanning
Generate codes for URL, text, Wi-Fi, email, phone and contact
Scan history with search, favourites and delete
No account, no ads and no internet required
Liquid Gradient Glass interface
changelog: Added settings and haptic feedback options

name: VaultNote
description: Encrypted offline notes. Your notes. Your privacy.
fullDescription: VaultNote keeps your notes encrypted with AES-256-GCM using keys held in the Android Keystore. Organise notes in coloured folders, add tags, lock individual notes and protect the whole app with a PIN or biometrics. Everything works fully offline, with no analytics, ads or registration.
features: AES-256-GCM encrypted notes
PIN and biometric app lock with per-note locking
Folders, tags and folder colours
Markdown editor with undo and redo
Local search with recent searches
Encrypted backup and restore
AMOLED, light and system themes
changelog: 2.0.0: Rebuilt in Kotlin with a new black and white design
2.0.0: Added biometric unlock, tags, templates and per-note locking

name: DeadlineX
description: A calm deadline tracker with reminders that actually arrive.
fullDescription: DeadlineX helps you stay ahead of every due date. Add deadlines, see what is coming next and get local reminders 24 hours, 1 hour and 15 minutes before, plus at the deadline itself. Reminders are restored after a restart and work without an internet connection. Built to stay light on low-end devices.
features: Reminders at 24 hours, 1 hour, 15 minutes and at the deadline
Reminders restored after device restart
Works fully offline with data stored on your device
Light and dark Liquid Glass interface
Optimised for low-end Android devices
changelog: 2.0.0: Native Android app with reliable local notifications
2.0.0: New Liquid Glass design and performance improvements
